title: Handshakes at the Party
summary: Solve a smaller version first and look for the pattern.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: Five friends meet at a party. Each person shakes hands once with every other person.
How many handshakes happen in total?
points: Five friends meet at a party. Each person shakes hands once with every other person.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Do not count people times people, because that counts each handshake twice.
Try a smaller party first: 2 people, then 3, then 4.
points: Do not count people times people, because that counts each handshake twice.

steps.title: The method: Try smaller cases
sentences: With 2 people there is 1 handshake. With 3 people there are 3. With 4 people there are 6.
Each new person shakes hands with everyone already there.
So the numbers go 1, 3, 6, 10, which add 2, then 3, then 4.
points: With 2 people there is 1 handshake. With 3 people there are 3. With 4 people there are 6.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: A quick rule: each of the 5 people shakes 4 hands, which is 20, but every handshake was counted twice, so divide by 2.
In general, n people make n times (n minus 1) divided by 2 handshakes.
